solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fear of being wrongly partitioned

indicators.note: wrongly tells us the letters of the next word are put together in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Someone dreads being divided up against their will.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' rearranges the eleven letters of PARTITIONED; 'of being' just links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepidation is a state of anxious dread, a near synonym of fear.

clue.text: Record attendance of pupils for lecture

definitions.meaning: a teacher marks each child present on the register with a check mark
to lecture someone is to scold or reprimand them

explanation.surface: A teacher marks the register before giving the class a talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' links the two senses. The second is British informal: to tick someone off is to tell them off.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb covers both marking names on a list and giving someone a dressing-down.

clue.text: Peer in uniform

definitions.meaning: a peer is someone of the same standing, a match
uniform as an adjective means the same throughout, even

explanation.surface: A member of the House of Lords dressed in uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peer' suggests a British noble and 'uniform' clothing, but both are used in their plainer senses; 'in' links them.
explanation.definitionFit: As noun it means a person of matching rank; as adjective it means unvarying or even.

clue.text: Entangled but certain it can be unravelled

indicators.note: unravelling something tangled undoes and rearranges it, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Something knotted up but sure to come loose with effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be unravelled' rearranges CERTAIN plus IT; 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intricate is complicated and full of interwoven parts, as a tangle is.

clue.text: A point we follow up, once more

indicators.note: follow means the next piece comes after the earlier ones

parts.note: N is a compass point, north

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, so backwards

explanation.surface: A speaker raises a point to be pursued later once again.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'up' reads a word from bottom to top, and 'follow' puts that piece last.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something anew means doing it again, afresh, once more.

clue.text: Maintained it's Enid's move

indicators.note: move tells us the letters of these words are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone claims that it is Enid's turn in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'move' rearranges the letters of IT'S ENID'S (apostrophes ignored).
explanation.definitionFit: To have insisted is to have maintained or asserted something firmly.

clue.text: Bottle neck

definitions.meaning: neck in informal use means cheek or audacity

explanation.surface: The narrow top of a glass bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words look like parts of a container, but each is British slang for daring: 'bottle' is courage and 'neck' is cheek.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve means courage or brazen boldness, matching both slang senses.

clue.text: Adam upset, bolted out fast

indicators.note: out here means the word for bolted lies outside the other piece

parts.note: bolted means ran off

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the name is read backwards

explanation.surface: Adam was upset and ran out of the room quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns the name round and 'out' wraps the word for bolted around it. 'fast' looks like speed but is the noun for a period without food.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramadan is the Muslim month of daytime fasting, so it is a fast in the noun sense.

clue.text: Latin American country holds an alternative view

indicators.note: holds means one piece contains the other

parts.note: Panama is a country in Central America
or is the word that introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A Latin American nation offers a different perspective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an' is a link word; 'holds' places the alternative after the country's first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide, unbroken view of a landscape.

clue.text: Be not as important as many

definitions.meaning: too numerous to tally means very many

explanation.surface: To matter less than lots of others.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words the answer means 'matter less'; as one word it means too many to number. 'as' links the two.
explanation.definitionFit: Countless means innumerable, a stronger way of saying a great many.

clue.text: Kingdom not fancied by many

parts.note: something not fancied or imagined is real
M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many

explanation.surface: A monarchy that most people dislike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancied' suggests being liked, but here 'not fancied' means not imaginary.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom, the territory ruled by a monarch.

clue.text: A boring set-up

parts.note: boring is read not as dull but as drilling, so this is an installation made for drilling holes in the seabed

explanation.surface: A dull arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshore platform drills wells for petroleum, literally a structure built for boring.

clue.text: Starfish disclosed by tides or a storm

indicators.note: a storm churns things up, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A starfish uncovered on the beach after tides and rough weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'storm' rearranges TIDES OR A; 'disclosed by' links. A starfish belongs to the zoological class Asteroidea.
explanation.definitionFit: Asteroid is the zoologists' name for a starfish, a member of the class Asteroidea.

clue.text: Make-up puts mother in a strong position

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a fort is a fortified, strong position
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone puts their mother somewhere secure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make-up' suggests cosmetics but means arrangement or layout.
explanation.definitionFit: The format of something is its make-up: its arrangement, layout or structure.

clue.text: Journalist about to take a drink

parts.note: re is a Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning
porter is a dark beer

explanation.surface: A newspaperman is about to go for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take' links the pieces; PORTER is a dark British beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A reporter is a journalist who gathers and writes news.

clue.text: Check the remainder before the downpour

indicators.note: before means this piece comes ahead of the next

parts.note: the rest is what remains
a downpour is heavy rain

explanation.surface: Someone checks the leftover items before the heavy rain comes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' is a verb here, meaning hold back.
explanation.definitionFit: To restrain is to hold in check, keep under control.

clue.text: Rate reform more certain — official

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so this word's letters are reordered

parts.note: surer means more certain

explanation.surface: A change to the rates is a surer policy, says an official.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' rearranges RATE to TREA.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer is the official in charge of an organisation's funds.

clue.text: Is stated in a way that creates revulsion

indicators.note: in a way here means put in a different manner, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something said in a certain manner makes people feel disgust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a way' rearranges IS STATED; 'that creates' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Distaste is a feeling of dislike or mild disgust, akin to revulsion.

clue.text: For dessert such an order can't be bettered

definitions.meaning: a baked fruit pudding with pastry

definitions.text: such an order can't be bettered
definitions.meaning: ... order is a set phrase for perfect neatness

explanation.surface: Ordering this pudding is the best choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' links. The second sense relies on the idiom 'in apple-pie order', meaning perfectly tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a pastry pudding and, in the idiom, the perfect order nothing can improve on.

clue.text: Refuse to vote, putting Jack on the spot

indicators.note: in a down clue on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is another
a stain is a spot or mark

explanation.surface: Someone declines to vote when Jack is put on the spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting' links; 'on the spot' looks like an idiom but supplies placement and STAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to decline formally to cast a vote.

clue.text: The cad is out to break the engagement

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A scoundrel is determined to end his engagement to be married.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges THE CAD; 'is' and 'to' link. 'Engagement' suggests a betrothal but means things being connected.
explanation.definitionFit: To detach is to disconnect or disengage, breaking a connection between parts.

clue.text: Female entertainer

parts.note: entertainer suggests a performer, but this is a woman who entertains guests at home

explanation.surface: A woman who performs on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who receives and looks after guests is the one entertaining them.

clue.text: They may have to wait for their money

definitions.text: They may have to wait for their money

parts.words: They may have to wait for their money
parts.note: wait suggests delay over pay, but waiting at table is the job of domestic staff

explanation.surface: People whose payment is delayed.
explanation.definitionFit: Household staff wait on their employers at table and earn wages for doing it.

clue.text: They are used to having high scores

definitions.text: They are used to having high scores

parts.words: They are used to having high scores
parts.note: high scores suggests top marks, but here means vocal parts written in a high register

explanation.surface: Successful people accustomed to top results.
explanation.definitionFit: These singers take the higher voice parts in written music for a choir.

clue.text: Judge gives direction to fools

parts.note: asses are fools
S is the compass direction south

explanation.surface: A judge gives instructions to some foolish people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives' and 'to' link; 'Judge' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess is to judge or evaluate the worth of something.

clue.text: Shun fallen woman bearing a daughter

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so one piece holds the others inside

parts.note: Eve fell from grace in Eden

explanation.surface: People avoid a disgraced woman who is carrying a child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bearing' puts A and D inside EVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade someone is to avoid or shun them.

clue.text: A number with deposit money

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
ash is a deposit left by burning or a volcano

explanation.surface: Someone makes a payment into a bank account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deposit' suggests banking, but it is the residue ASH; 'A' and 'with' link.
explanation.definitionFit: Cash is money in notes and coins.

clue.text: In skill the French sentry should be

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: art is a skill or craft
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A sentry should be both skilled and French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sentry should be' is a descriptive definition: what a sentry must be.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentry on guard must be watchful and vigilant at all times.

clue.text: Domestic flight

parts.note: domestic flight suggests an internal air journey, but read as a set of steps inside a home

explanation.surface: A plane journey within one country.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of stairs inside a house is a household set of steps.

clue.text: The lamb's tender

parts.note: tender suggests soft meat, but here is a noun: the woman who tends the lambs

explanation.surface: The lamb is soft to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who looks after a flock tends its young sheep.
